messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: HPA metrics-adapter error-rate spike detected for gpu-serving namespace. Autoscaler reports delayed metrics for 12m, queue depth growing. Severity: P1. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hpa-metrics-adapter

oncall-anna: I'm paged (oncall-anna). diving in. checking HPA status and queue lengths.

oncall-anna: `kubectl get hpa -n gpu-serving` shows current: 0, desired: 12 for inferencer-deploy (should be scaling). but HPA controller complains: "custom.metrics API unavailable"

sre-maya: saw increased 429s from metrics-adapter to prometheus, and adapter logs show backlog: `queue_size=1.2k backlog_ms_avg=24000`

oncall-anna: looking at prometheus targets -> scrape_latency spiked. prometheus is under heavy write/read due to nightly ingest (remote_write to longterm store). maybe throttling local queries.

infra-jay: I'm joining. can we failover HPA metrics to metrics-server or node-level metric temporarily?

ml-ops-kim: we have a fallback metric (gpu_utilization via metrics-server) but thresholds differ. risk of overscale / cost spike.

oncall-anna: quick mitigation plan: 1) ack and page infra for manual nodepool bump 2) restart metrics-adapter to clear backlog 3) if restart not enough, manually scale inferencer replicas to cover immediate customer impact 4) notify support and customers.

infra-jay: bumping nodepool autoscaler to +8 nodes now (manual override). running: `gcloud container clusters resize redwood-prod --node-pool gpu-pool --num-nodes 24`

support-lee: opening customer incident tickets for customers on dedicated-gpu plans (list pulled from billing). telling them we're actively mitigating and will provide ETA.

oncall-anna: restarting metrics-adapter (monitoring namespace). `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/metrics-adapter`

incident-bot: system: deployment/metrics-adapter restarted at 2350001258.

oncall-anna: adapter logs useful snippet:

```
2026-03-15T09:20:12Z metrics-adapter warn: read_prometheus_query failed: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc=transport is closing
2026-03-15T09:20:13Z metrics-adapter info: processed backlog=1200 processed_ms=32000
```

sre-maya: after restart, adapter queue dropped to ~30 and error rate back to normal. HPA controller polling resumed.

oncall-anna: HPA now recommending desired=10 for inferencer-deploy. issuing manual scale to be safe: `kubectl -n gpu-serving scale deployment/inferencer-deploy --replicas=10`

ml-ops-kim: monitoring model latency and token throughput. we'll toggle fallback routing to cheaper model if latency persists.

infra-jay: nodepool increase completed at 2350001290. nodes joining. GPU utilization still high but autoscaling requests accepted now.

prod-ryan: customer-facing note draft: "We experienced degraded autoscaling due to delayed metrics ingestion causing inference capacity to lag. We’ve applied mitigations (metrics-adapter restart, temporary manual scaling). Full postmortem to follow." Approve? :thumbsup:

support-lee: approved, posting to status page and support tickets now.

oncall-anna: handing off to infra-jay for follow-ups and RCA. Handoff summary:
- cause: Prometheus query latency and remote_write pressure created timeouts; metrics-adapter accumulated backlog -> custom metrics unavailable -> HPA didn't scale in time
- mitigations applied: metrics-adapter restart, temporary manual scale of inferencer replicas, nodepool manual bump, customer notifications
- next steps: capture prometheus scrape/write metrics, inspect retention/remote_write throughput, consider circuit-breaker on adapter and fallback routing for HPA queries

infra-jay: taking over. created postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2350001234-hpa-delay-prom-queue. assigned owners for prometheus tuning and adapter resilience.

sre-maya: action items: 1) add alert when adapter queue > 200 for >5m 2) implement graceful degradation for HPA to use metrics-server when custom metrics unresponsive 3) review remote_write throttling window.

oncall-anna: closing the on-call thread. leaving notes in incident log and handoff channel. thanks all. :heart:

incident-bot: incident update: mitigated at 2350001389. automating follow-up assignment and severity review.
summary: P1: GPU autoscaling delayed due to Prometheus/metrics-adapter backlog; mitigations included adapter restart, manual scaling, nodepool bump, customer notifications, and handoff for RCA.
